item.title: @elonmusk: I think people are significantly underestimating just how much FSD has become a major driver of Tesl...
item.description: I think people are significantly underestimating just how much FSD has become a major driver of Tesla sales in North America. When I ask most people buying their first Tesla why they’re getting it, they now say: FSD. This wasn't the case even early this year. There has been a real shift these last 3-6 months in terms of awareness of this technology.
